analysis.purpose: The memory freshness engine: an independent evaluator that recomputes whether a remembered claim is still trustworthy, still evidenced, still applicable, and still live — deliberately separate from the enrichment staleness path.
responsibilities: Recompute a four-axis verdict: trust, evidence, applicability and lifecycle
Apply a per-claim-kind minimum-evidence matrix before admitting a claim
Re-ground evidence against the current code and reattach moved anchors
Decide quarantine and supersession rather than silently dropping records

businessRules.rule: Memory freshness is evaluated by a separate engine and never by reusing the enrichment staleness check.
businessRules.rationale: The two ask different questions; sharing the code path would couple unrelated invalidation rules.

businessRules.rule: Evidence admissibility depends on the kind of claim being made, via an explicit matrix.
businessRules.rationale: A decision needs different support than a pitfall; one threshold for all would be wrong for both.

edges.rationale: This file implements the memory evaluator.
